headline: PSX posts highest-ever single-day gain of over 14,000 points
summary: The Pakistan Stock Exchange surged by more than 14,000 points on Wednesday, its highest-ever single-day gain. The rally followed a development in Pakistan that the report did not detail.
why: The Pakistan Stock Exchange is the main equity market in Pakistan, and index moves reflect investor sentiment about the country's economy. Sharp swings are common in frontier markets.
why_moved: The exchange surged more than 14,000 points on Wednesday after a development in Pakistan, according to the report, which did not specify the trigger in full.
